name: Purpleish Blue
lede: Purpleish Blue is a strong, vivid blue-violet, built by bolting "purpleish" onto [[blue]] in the 2010 xkcd color survey.

sections.title: A compound crowd name
sections.body:
The name follows the survey's modifier grammar: purpleish plus a base color word, here blue [1]. It carries no older record; the xkcd survey of 2010 is the only source on file [1]. The ISCC-NBS system would class it a strong purplish blue, though the fit is loose, 11.8 units off [1].

Its nearest named neighbor is [[bluish-purple]], just 2.4 units away and almost the same color [2]. [[blurple]] sits a little further off, and the survey's own near-duplicate, [[blurple]], is 4.9 units away and more vivid still [2].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our 23,781-painting archive matches this color across even a small share of its canvas, as photographed [3]. This is one of the archive's higher-chroma blues, and intense, saturated colors are rare survivors on an aged, varnished canvas [3]. The absence describes this archive, not painting in general [3].
